# Windows toolchain notices

The Windows preview uses GCC 13.2.0 and MinGW-w64 11.0.1. Its GCC C++/exception
and Winpthreads runtimes are statically linked. These upstream notices are
retained verbatim. SDL2 remains a shared host dependency.
